数据组件

字典选择器 AsamDictSelect

在选择器上管理字典选项、重载和请求取消。

字典选择器 ​

在选择器上管理字典选项、重载和请求取消。

基础用法 ​

示例通过本地 provider 获取字典，支持模型更新、暂停与重载。所有请求都留在演示内部。

点击“读取当前标签”读取实例的只读 selectedLabel：空模型返回空字符串，选择后返回当前标签。 完整说明。

本地字典与生命周期

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div ref="host" />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { provider } from './provider.js';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectBasicDemoExample' });

const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp(Child);
	provideAsamData(app, provider, { scope: 'doc-status' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>
vue
<template>
	<section class="data-demo demo-spacing-1">
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active">启用请求</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="multipleMode">启用多选</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamDictSelect
			v-if="!multipleMode"
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			dict-type="doc-status"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		>
			<template #prefix><span aria-hidden="true">状态</span></template>
		</AsamDictSelect>
		<AsamDictSelect
			v-else
			ref="control"
			v-model="multipleValue"
			multiple
			dict-type="doc-status"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		>
			<template #prefix><span aria-hidden="true">状态</span></template>
		</AsamDictSelect>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" :disabled="!active" @click="reload">
			强制重载
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()">
			取消请求
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="readSelectedLabel">
			读取当前标签
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="control?.focus()">
			聚焦选择器
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @mousedown.prevent @click="control?.blur()">
			失焦选择器
		</AsamButton>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }} {{ error }}</p>
		<pre>{{ multipleMode ? multipleValue : value }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="selected-label">{{ selectedLabel }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectBasicExample' });
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamDictSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAsyncSelectExpose, AsamDictEntry } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref<string | null>(null);
const active = ref(true);
const multipleMode = ref(false);
const multipleValue = ref<string[]>([]);
const control = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<string, AsamDictEntry>>();
const selectedLabel = ref<string | string[]>('');
function readSelectedLabel() {
	selectedLabel.value = control.value?.selectedLabel ?? '';
}
const error = ref('');
const result = ref('');
async function reload() {
	const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.demo-spacing-1 {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>
ts
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';

export const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
	dict: {
		async refresh(context) {
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
		},
		async get(dictType, context) {
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			if (dictType !== 'doc-status') throw new Error('未知演示字典');
			return [
				{ label: '准备', value: 'ready' },
				{ label: '进行', value: 'running' }
			];
		}
	}
};

本地创建与字典规范项 ​

allow-create 与 filterable 开启后，createOption(text) 同步返回完整 AsamOption<V, I>。 默认创建值为字符串；数字、布尔值或自定义 raw 必须提供类型一致的同步工厂。 示例包含独立 provider 初始化、完整实体工厂和来源接受同值项的对照。

本地创建、规范项与来源重置

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template><div ref="host" /></template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createDemoState, createDemoProvider } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectLocalCreationDemo' });
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const state = createDemoState();
	app = createApp(Child);
	app.provide('selection-local-demo', state);
	provideAsamData(app, createDemoProvider(state), { scope: 'selection-demo' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>
vue
<template>
	<section class="data-demo demo-spacing-1">
		<div class="actions">
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reload">强制重载</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.clearCreatedOptions()">
				清空本地创建集合
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="value = null">
				清空模型
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				native-type="button"
				@click="tenant = tenant === 'a' ? 'b' : 'a'"
			>
				切换逻辑来源
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">模拟失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="canonical">来源接受 Omega 同值项</AsamCheckboxItem>
		</div>
		<AsamDictSelect
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:dict-type="tenant"
			:create-option="createOption"
			value-mode="object"
			allow-create
			filterable
			clearable
			size="default"

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { inject, nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamDictSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption, AsamCreateOption, AsamValue, AsamAsyncSelectExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { DemoState, Member } from './provider.js';
const state = inject<DemoState>('selection-local-demo');
if (!state) throw new Error('Demo.vue 必须先配置演示 provider。');
const { tenant, failure, canonical } = state;
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectLocalCreationChild' });
const value = ref<AsamOption<string, Member> | null>(null);
const control = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<string, Member>>();
const createdTexts = ref<string[]>([]);
const providerValues = ref<AsamValue[]>([]);
const message = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const createOption: AsamCreateOption<string, Member> = (text) => {
	createdTexts.value.push(text);
	return { label: text, value: text, raw: { id: 'local-' + text, label: text, value: text } };
};

async function reload() {
	await nextTick();
	result.value = (await control.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	if (result.value === 'success') message.value = '';
}

ts
import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider, AsamDictEntry } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Member extends AsamDictEntry {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly value: string;
}
export function createDemoState() {
	return { tenant: ref('a'), failure: ref(false), canonical: ref(false) };
}
export type DemoState = ReturnType<typeof createDemoState>;
export function createDemoProvider(state: DemoState): AsamDataProvider {
	return {
		dict: {
			async refresh(context) {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			},
			async get(type, context) {
				await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 150));
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				if (state.failure.value) throw new Error('演示字典失败');
				if (!['a', 'b'].includes(type)) throw new Error('未知演示字典');
				const items: Member[] = [{ id: 'server', label: 'Server', value: 'server' }];
				if (state.canonical.value)
					items.push({ id: 'saved', label: 'Server Omega', value: 'Omega' });
				return items;
			}
		}
	};
}

import { ref } from 'vue';
export function createDemoState() {
	return { tenant: ref('a'), failure: ref(false), canonical: ref(false) };
}
export function createDemoProvider(state) {
	return {
		dict: {
			async refresh(context) {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			},
			async get(type, context) {
				await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 150));
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				if (state.failure.value) throw new Error('演示字典失败');
				if (!['a', 'b'].includes(type)) throw new Error('未知演示字典');
				const items = [{ id: 'server', label: 'Server', value: 'server' }];
				if (state.canonical.value)
					items.push({ id: 'saved', label: 'Server Omega', value: 'Omega' });
				return items;
			}
		}
	};
}

本地创建集合只属于当前组件，不写入字典 provider/cache，success 只含来源项。 同类型同值去重，字典同值规范项优先；已传给父组件的对象模型不会因刷新自动替换。

clearCreatedOptions() 只清空本地集合及基础文本 memo，不清空模型。相同字典刷新、 一般 epoch 更新与错误重试保留本地项；dictType、dictValueType、真实 dataSource 或 provider/scope 变化自动清空。清空模型仍由调用方另行更新 v-model。

数据来源与覆盖 ​

dictType 与 dataSource 只选一种；dataSource 使用 defineAsamDictSource 创建，不能再传 dictValueType。 完整说明。

单选值模式使用标量或 null；对象模式使用规范化 AsamOption。多选的数组与分隔字符串模式由 multiple、valueMode、multipleValueMode 联合约束；对象模式不能使用字符串存储。切换值策略时同时调整模型类型。

来源接管 options、loading 和远端查询；数据组件不开放基础选择器的 native 值模式。基础页中只使用与本组件公开分支兼容的能力。

生命周期、事件与实例 ​

active=false 暂停请求并保留上次成功数据；reload({ force: true }) 请求新数据，cancel() 取消当前请求。 完整说明。

immediate 控制初始化是否请求，active 控制请求是否启用。初始化和默认值以本页自动 API 的原始来源为准。

插槽与基础能力 ​

prefix、header、footer、empty、loading、tag、label 等插槽保留各自基础作用域；selectedLabel 为只读标签结果，focus/blur 用于焦点控制。虚拟选择器 default 插槽使用基础虚拟选项作用域。

本站继承关系 ​

  • 选择器：适用的基础展示、交互与公开 API。

本页数据来源、模型、事件和实例的覆盖规则优先；本站链接不扩大本组件公开契约。尺寸使用基础组件的 ASAM 尺寸规则，示例使用 default。

字典刷新与示例 Provider ​

强制重载会先调用 provider.dict.refresh，再重新读取字典。示例 provider 同时提供 get 和 refresh，并检查请求取消信号；使用固定字典数据，不连接真实后端。宿主接入时应在 refresh 中实现实际缓存更新。

选项和标签的完整展示 ​

完整示例在两个独立实例中演示按来源 raw.team 分组的 OptionGroup/Option 插槽、prefix/header/footer/loading/empty/label 和可删除 tag。 完整说明。

示例按钮可关闭或恢复标签折叠，将可见标签数量在 1 与 3 之间切换，并将多选数量上限在 3 与 0（不限数量）之间切换。展示设置不改变来源和已选模型；取消上限后可以选择第四项。恢复初始多选由调用方将模型设回 [1, 3, 4]，随后恢复上限，区别于用户删除标签触发的 remove-tag。

展示示例还逐次记录单选原始数字、多选原始数组的 update:modelValue/change，以及完整规范化选项的 success。可制造一次刷新失败，观察 error 的 kind/message 与旧选中值保留，再恢复；持有请求的取消不产生额外成功事件。每条记录保存独立载荷快照。

选项模板、标签折叠与加载插槽

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, inject, ref } from 'vue';
import type { StyleValue } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDictSelect, AsamOption, AsamOptionGroup } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamSelectDataEmits,
	AsamValue,
	AsamDataError,
	AsamOption as DataOption,
	AsamAsyncSelectExpose,
	AsamRecord
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { DemoState } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectNativePresentationChild' });
const injected = inject<DemoState>('selection-presentation');
if (!injected) throw new Error('Demo.vue must install its local provider before Child.vue mounts.');
const state: DemoState = injected;
const singleControl = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<number, AsamRecord>>();
const singleValue = ref<number | null>(null);
type DataEmits = AsamSelectDataEmits<AsamValue, object>;
const dataEvents = ref<
	readonly {
		readonly mode: 'single' | 'multiple';
		readonly name: string;
		readonly payload: unknown;
	}[]
>([]);
const eventResult = ref('');
function recordEvent(mode: 'single' | 'multiple', name: string, payload: unknown) {
	const snapshot: unknown = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
	dataEvents.value = [...dataEvents.value, { mode, name, payload: snapshot }];
}
function onModelUpdate(payload: DataEmits['update:modelValue'][0], mode: 'single' | 'multiple') {
	recordEvent(mode, 'update:modelValue', payload);
}
function onModelChange(payload: DataEmits['change'][0], mode: 'single' | 'multiple') {
	recordEvent(mode, 'change', payload);
}
function onSuccess(payload: DataEmits['success'][0]) {
	recordEvent('single', 'success', payload);
}
function onError(payload: AsamDataError) {
	recordEvent('single', 'error', { kind: payload.kind, message: payload.message });
}
async function failReload() {
	state.failure.value = true;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function recoverReload() {
	state.failure.value = false;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function cancelHeld() {
	state.held.value = true;
	const pending = singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => singleControl.value?.cancel(), 30);
	eventResult.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	state.release();
}
const multipleValues = ref<readonly number[]>([1, 3, 4]);
const removed = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const customTag = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const collapseTags = ref(true);
const collapseTagsTooltip = ref(true);
const popperStyleMode = ref<'object' | 'string' | 'array' | 'false' | 'null' | 'undefined'>(
	'object'
);
const popperStyle = computed<StyleValue>(() => {
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'object') return { minWidth: '320px' };
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'string') return 'min-width: 360px';
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'array') return [{ minWidth: '400px' }, [{ maxWidth: '460px' }]];
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'false') return false;
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'null') return null;
	return undefined;
});
const maxCollapseTags = ref(1);
const multipleLimit = ref(3);
const singleOptions = ref<readonly DataOption<number, AsamRecord>[]>([]);
const groups = computed(() =>
	['一组', '二组'].map((team) => ({
		team,
		options: singleOptions.value.filter((item) => item.raw.team === team)
	}))
);

function holdAndReload() {
	state.held.value = true;
	void singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.demo-spacing-1 {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);

ts
import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Member {
	readonly label: string;
	readonly value: number;
	readonly id: number;
	readonly team: string;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
}
const rows: readonly Member[] = [
	{ label: 'Alpha', value: 1, id: 1, team: '一组' },
	{ label: 'Beta', value: 2, id: 2, team: '一组', disabled: true },
	{ label: 'Gamma', value: 3, id: 3, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Delta', value: 4, id: 4, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Epsilon', value: 5, id: 5, team: '二组' }
];
export function createDemoState() {
	const held = ref(false),
		empty = ref(false),
		failure = ref(false),
		calls = ref(0);
	const pending = new Set<() => void>();
	async function read(signal: AbortSignal, text: string) {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		calls.value++;
		if (held.value)
			await new Promise<void>((done, reject) => {
				const finish = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					done();
				};
				const abort = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(signal.reason);
				};
				pending.add(finish);
				signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (signal.aborted) abort();
			});
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示选择器请求失败');
		return empty.value
			? []
			: rows.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase()));
	}
	function release() {
		held.value = false;
		for (const finish of [...pending]) finish();
	}
	return { held, empty, failure, calls, read, release };
}
export type DemoState = ReturnType<typeof createDemoState>;
export function createDemoProvider(state: DemoState): AsamDataProvider {
	return {
		dict: {
			async refresh(context) {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			},
			async get(type, context) {
				if (type !== 'presentation') throw new Error('Unknown local dictionary');
				return (await state.read(context.signal, '')).map((item) => ({ ...item }));
			}
		}
	};
}

import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';

import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createDemoState, createDemoProvider } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectNativePresentationDemo' });
const host = ref();
let app;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const state = createDemoState();
	app = createApp(Child);
	app.provide('selection-presentation', state);
	provideAsamData(app, createDemoProvider(state), { scope: 'native-presentation' });

});

</script>

			</template>
			<template #label="{ label, value }">

			</template>
			<template #default>
				<AsamOptionGroup v-for="group in groups" :key="group.team" :label="group.team">
					<AsamOption
						v-for="option in group.options"
						:key="option.value"
						:label="option.label"
						:value="option.value"
						:disabled="option.disabled"
					>
						<span>{{ option.label }} · {{ option.raw.team }}</span>

				</AsamOptionGroup>

		<label>多选展示</label>

			dict-type="presentation"

			multiple

			:collapse-tags-tooltip="collapseTagsTooltip"
			:max-collapse-tags="maxCollapseTags"
			:multiple-limit="multipleLimit"
			:disabled="disabled"
			style="width: 280px"
			clearable
			placeholder="演示多选"
			:teleported="false"
			@remove-tag="removed.push($event)"
			@update:model-value="onModelUpdate($event, 'multiple')"
			@change="onModelChange($event, 'multiple')"
		>
			<template v-if="customTag" #tag="{ data, deleteTag }">
				<span data-testid="presentation-tag">
					已选 {{ data.length }} 项
					<AsamButton
						type="default"
						native-type="button"
						:disabled="disabled || !data.length"

				singleValue,
				multipleValues,
				removed,
				customTag,
				disabled,
				collapseTags,
				collapseTagsTooltip,
				popperStyleMode,
				maxCollapseTags,
				multipleLimit,
				calls: state.calls.value
			})
		}}</pre>
		<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="selection-event-result">{{ eventResult }}</p>
		<pre data-testid="selection-data-events">{{ JSON.stringify(dataEvents) }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed, inject, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDictSelect, AsamOption, AsamOptionGroup } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectNativePresentationChild' });
const injected = inject('selection-presentation');
if (!injected) throw new Error('Demo.vue must install its local provider before Child.vue mounts.');
const state = injected;
const singleControl = ref();
const singleValue = ref(null);
const dataEvents = ref([]);
const eventResult = ref('');
function recordEvent(mode, name, payload) {
	const snapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
	dataEvents.value = [...dataEvents.value, { mode, name, payload: snapshot }];
}
function onModelUpdate(payload, mode) {
	recordEvent(mode, 'update:modelValue', payload);
}
function onModelChange(payload, mode) {
	recordEvent(mode, 'change', payload);
}
function onSuccess(payload) {
	recordEvent('single', 'success', payload);
}
function onError(payload) {
	recordEvent('single', 'error', { kind: payload.kind, message: payload.message });
}
async function failReload() {
	state.failure.value = true;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function recoverReload() {
	state.failure.value = false;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function cancelHeld() {
	state.held.value = true;
	const pending = singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => singleControl.value?.cancel(), 30);
	eventResult.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	state.release();
}
const multipleValues = ref([1, 3, 4]);
const removed = ref([]);
const customTag = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const collapseTags = ref(true);
const collapseTagsTooltip = ref(true);
const popperStyleMode = ref('object');
const popperStyle = computed(() => {
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'object') return { minWidth: '320px' };
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'string') return 'min-width: 360px';
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'array') return [{ minWidth: '400px' }, [{ maxWidth: '460px' }]];
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'false') return false;
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'null') return null;
	return undefined;
});
const maxCollapseTags = ref(1);
const multipleLimit = ref(3);
const singleOptions = ref([]);
const groups = computed(() =>
	['一组', '二组'].map((team) => ({
		team,
		options: singleOptions.value.filter((item) => item.raw.team === team)
	}))
);
function holdAndReload() {
	state.held.value = true;
	void singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
}
</script>

完整示例从 @asam-ui/ui-yudao 导入实际 createYudaoProvider，并在独立子应用安装。 完整说明。

实际芋道桥接、共享确保与可选刷新

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="demo-layout-1">
		<div ref="host" />
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="showWithoutRefresh">
			展示未提供 refresh 的桥接
		</AsamButton>
		<div ref="withoutRefreshHost" data-testid="yudao-without-refresh" />
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="checkBridge">
			检查完整宿主桥
		</AsamButton>
		<pre data-testid="yudao-contract-result">{{ contractResult }}</pre>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="showUploadProtocol">
			展示上传数据协议
		</AsamButton>
		<div ref="uploadHost" />
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectYudaoBridgeDemo' });
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createBridge } from './provider.js';
import { runYudaoBridgeContract } from './contract.js';
import UploadConsumer from './UploadConsumer.vue';
import { createUploadDemo } from './upload.js';
const uploadHost = ref<HTMLElement>();
let uploadApp: App | undefined;
let uploadDemo: ReturnType<typeof createUploadDemo> | undefined;
function showUploadProtocol() {
	if (!uploadHost.value || uploadApp) return;
	uploadDemo = createUploadDemo();
	uploadApp = createApp(UploadConsumer);
	uploadApp.provide('data009-upload-demo', uploadDemo);
	provideAsamData(uploadApp, uploadDemo.provider, { scope: 'data009-upload-contract' });
	uploadApp.mount(uploadHost.value);
}
const contractResult = ref('未执行');
async function checkBridge() {
	try {
		contractResult.value = JSON.stringify(await runYudaoBridgeContract());
	} catch (error) {
		contractResult.value = JSON.stringify({
			status: 'FAIL',
			message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
		});
	}
}
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
const withoutRefreshHost = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
let withoutRefreshApp: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const demo = createBridge();
	app = createApp(Child);
	app.provide('yudao-bridge-demo', demo);
	provideAsamData(app, demo.provider, { scope: 'yudao-local-demo' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
function showWithoutRefresh() {
	if (!withoutRefreshHost.value || withoutRefreshApp) return;
	const demo = createBridge(false);
	withoutRefreshApp = createApp(Child);
	withoutRefreshApp.provide('yudao-bridge-demo', demo);
	provideAsamData(withoutRefreshApp, demo.provider, { scope: 'yudao-no-refresh-demo' });
	withoutRefreshApp.mount(withoutRefreshHost.value);
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	uploadApp?.unmount();
	uploadDemo?.releaseHeld();
	app?.unmount();
	withoutRefreshApp?.unmount();
});
</script>

<style scoped>
.demo-layout-1 {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { createYudaoProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui-yudao';
import type { AsamRequestContext } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface BridgeCall {
	readonly kind: 'ensure' | 'refresh';
	readonly scope: string;
	readonly epoch: number;
	readonly requestId: number;
}
/** Host cache and transport are local to this complete example; no URL is contacted. */
export function createBridge(supportsRefresh = true) {
	const state = reactive({
		supportsRefresh,
		generation: 0,
		slow: false,
		failure: false,
		aborts: 0,
		reads: 0,
		calls: [] as BridgeCall[]
	});
	let release: () => void = () => undefined;
	const record = (kind: BridgeCall['kind'], context: AsamRequestContext) =>
		state.calls.push({
			kind,
			scope: context.scope,
			epoch: context.epoch,
			requestId: context.requestId
		});
	const provider = createYudaoProvider({
		dict: {
			async ensure(context) {
				record('ensure', context);
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				if (state.slow)
					await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
						const abort = () => {
							state.aborts++;
							context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
							reject(context.signal.reason);
						};
						context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
						release = () => {
							context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
							resolve();
						};
					});
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				if (state.failure) throw new Error('Local host dictionary failed');
			},
			get(type) {
				if (type !== 'members') throw new Error('Unknown local dictionary');
				state.reads++;
				return [
					{ label: '第一成员 G' + state.generation, value: 1 },
					{ label: '第二成员 G' + state.generation, value: 2 }
				];
			},
			...(supportsRefresh
				? {
						async refresh(context: AsamRequestContext) {
							record('refresh', context);
							context.signal.throwIfAborted();
							state.generation++;
						}
					}
				: {})
		}
	});
	return { state, provider, release: () => release() };
}
export type BridgeDemo = ReturnType<typeof createBridge>;

<template>
	<section class="demo-spacing-1">

		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="demo.state.failure">

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { inject, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamDictSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAsyncSelectExpose, AsamRecord } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { BridgeDemo } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectYudaoBridgeChild' });
const injected = inject<BridgeDemo>('yudao-bridge-demo');
if (!injected) throw new Error('Demo.vue must provide its local bridge');
const demo = injected;
const first = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<number, AsamRecord>>();
const second = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<number, AsamRecord>>();
const firstValue = ref<number | null>(null);
const secondValue = ref<number | null>(null);
const firstStatus = ref('loading');
const secondStatus = ref('loading');
const transaction = ref('idle');
async function reload() {
	const results = await Promise.all([
		first.value?.reload({ force: true }),
		second.value?.reload({ force: true })
	]);
	transaction.value = results.map((result) => result?.status).join('/');
}
async function cached() {
	const results = await Promise.all([first.value?.reload(), second.value?.reload()]);
	transaction.value = results.map((result) => result?.status).join('/');
}
function hold() {
	demo.state.slow = true;
	transaction.value = 'waiting';
	void reload();
	first.value?.cancel();
}
function release() {
	demo.state.slow = false;
	demo.release();
}
</script>

import { createYudaoProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui-yudao';
import {
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions,
	resolveAsamOptions,
	resolveAsamPage
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamYudaoBridge } from '@asam-ui/ui-yudao';
import type {
	AsamRequestConfig,
	AsamRequestContext,
	AsamUploadInput,
	AsamUploadContext,
	AsamDataError
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

/** All transports and files are local fixtures; this function contacts no endpoint. */
export async function runYudaoBridgeContract() {
	const observations: { phase: string; state: unknown }[] = [];
	const check = (value: boolean, label: string) => {
		if (!value) throw Error(label);
	};
	const record = (phase: string, state: unknown) => observations.push({ phase, state });
	const requests: { config: AsamRequestConfig; context: AsamRequestContext }[] = [];
	const notices: AsamDataError[] = [];
	const ownedCause = Error('host already notified');
	const bridge: AsamYudaoBridge = {
		request: async (config, context) => {
			requests.push({ config, context });
			return { code: 0, data: [{ label: 'Local', value: 0 }] };
		},
		upload: async (config, input, context) => {
			context.reportProgress({ loaded: input.file.size, total: input.file.size });
			return { config, input, context };
		},
		isErrorNotified: (cause) => cause === ownedCause,
		onError: (error) => {
			notices.push(error);
		}
	};
	const provider = createYudaoProvider(bridge);
	check(requests.length === 0 && notices.length === 0, 'construction must be inert');
	check(
		provider.request === bridge.request &&
			provider.upload === bridge.upload &&
			provider.onError === bridge.onError &&
			provider.isErrorNotified === bridge.isErrorNotified,
		'callbacks must retain identity'
	);
	check(
		Object.isFrozen(provider) &&
			Object.isFrozen(provider.pagination) &&
			!Object.isFrozen(bridge),
		'freeze provider rather than host bridge'
	);
	record('yudao-inert-construction-frozen-provider-and-original-callbacks', {
		calls: requests.length,
		notices: notices.length,
		callbackIdentity: true,
		providerFrozen: true,
		paginationFrozen: true,
		hostFrozen: false,
		pagination: provider.pagination
	});
	const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({ provider, scope: 'yudao-contract' });
	const context = runtime.createContext();
	try {
		const params = { tenant: 'local' },
			data = { body: true };
		const source = defineAsamOptions().request({
			request: { url: '/local-contract', method: 'post', params, data }
		});
		const options = await resolveAsamOptions(source, { provider, context });
		check(
			requests.length === 1 && requests[0]!.context === context,
			'request context identity'
		);
		check(
			requests[0]!.config.params === params && requests[0]!.config.data === data,
			'request payload ownership'
		);
		check(options[0]!.value === 0, 'request unwrap and core normalization');
		record('yudao-real-core-request-context-and-payload-ownership', {
			url: requests[0]!.config.url,
			method: requests[0]!.config.method,
			scope: context.scope,
			sameContext: true,
			sameParams: true,
			sameData: true,
			values: options.map((o) => o.value)
		});
		const progress: number[] = [],
			input: AsamUploadInput = {
				file: new File(['abc'], 'local.txt', { type: 'text/plain' }),
				fieldName: 'attachment',
				data: { tenant: 'local', payload: new Blob(['z']) }
			};
		const uploadContext: AsamUploadContext = {
			...context,
			reportProgress: (p) => {
				progress.push(p.loaded);
			}
		};
		const config = { url: '/local-upload', method: 'put' as const, params };
		const uploaded = await provider.upload!(config, input, uploadContext);
		if (typeof uploaded !== 'object' || uploaded === null) throw Error('upload echo');
		check(
			Reflect.get(uploaded, 'input') === input &&
				Reflect.get(uploaded, 'context') === uploadContext &&
				Reflect.get(uploaded, 'config') === config,
			'upload passthrough identity'
		);
		check(progress.length === 1 && progress[0] === 3, 'upload progress forwarding');
		record('yudao-upload-original-transport-and-progress-passthrough', {
			sameConfig: true,
			sameInput: true,
			sameContext: true,
			name: input.file.name,
			fieldName: input.fieldName,
			progress
		});
		const row = { label: 'Decoded', value: false };
		const values: (string | number | boolean)[] = [];
		for (const response of [
			[row],
			{ data: [row] },
			{ code: 0, data: [row] },
			{ code: 200, data: [row] }
		]) {
			const source = defineAsamOptions().api({
				api: async () => response,
				params: undefined
			});
			values.push((await resolveAsamOptions(source, { provider, context }))[0]!.value);
		}
		const badCodes: unknown[] = ['0', 500, null, undefined];
		const failures: string[] = [];
		for (const response of [
			...badCodes.map((code) => ({ code, data: [row] })),
			{ code: 0, data: { data: [row] } }
		]) {
			try {
				await resolveAsamOptions(
					defineAsamOptions().api({ api: async () => response, params: undefined }),
					{ provider, context }
				);
				throw Error('invalid response accepted');
			} catch (error) {
				check(
					typeof error === 'object' &&
						error !== null &&
						Reflect.get(error, 'kind') === 'response',
					'one-envelope response rejection'
				);
				failures.push('response');
			}
		}
		check(
			values.length === 4 && values.every((value) => value === false),
			'accepted envelopes preserve false'
		);
		record('yudao-one-layer-options-and-five-response-rejections', { values, failures });
		const pages = [
			{ list: [{ id: 0 }], total: 1 },
			{ code: 0, data: { list: [{ id: 0 }], total: 1 } },
			{ code: 200, list: [{ id: 0 }], total: 1 }
		].map((response) => resolveAsamPage(response, undefined, provider));
		for (const page of pages)
			check(page.total === 1 && page.list[0]!.id === 0, 'page decoding');
		let ambiguous = false;
		try {
			resolveAsamPage(
				{ code: 0, list: [{ id: 1 }], total: 1, data: { list: [{ id: 2 }], total: 1 } },
				undefined,
				provider
			);
		} catch (error) {
			ambiguous =
				typeof error === 'object' &&
				error !== null &&
				Reflect.get(error, 'kind') === 'response';
		}
		check(ambiguous, 'competing page paths rejected');
		record('yudao-page-default-keys-one-envelope-and-ambiguity', {
			pages: pages.map((page) => ({
				ids: page.list.map((row) => row.id),
				total: page.total
			})),
			ambiguous
		});
		const owned: AsamDataError = {
			kind: 'request',
			message: 'owned',
			cause: ownedCause,
			notified: false
		};
		const ownedResult = runtime.reportError(owned, context);
		check(
			ownedResult.notified && notices.length === 0,
			'host ownership suppresses duplicate notice'
		);
		const fresh: AsamDataError = {
			kind: 'request',
			message: 'new',
			cause: Error('new'),
			notified: false
		};
		const first = runtime.reportError(fresh, context),
			second = runtime.reportError(fresh, context);
		check(
			first === second && notices.length === 1 && first.notified,
			'normal notice deduplicates'
		);
		record('yudao-explicit-host-error-ownership-and-notice-deduplication', {
			hostOwnedNotified: ownedResult.notified,
			freshNotified: first.notified,
			notices: notices.length,
			sameReportedError: first === second
		});
		const invalid: unknown[] = [
			null,
			[],
			'bridge',
			{ request: 1 },
			{ upload: 1 },
			{ isErrorNotified: true },
			{ onError: true },
			{ dict: null },
			{ dict: [] },
			{ dict: {} },
			{ dict: { ensure: async () => {}, get: 1 } },
			{ dict: { ensure: 1, get: () => [] } },
			{ dict: { ensure: async () => {}, get: () => [], refresh: 1 } }
		];
		const rejected: string[] = [];
		for (const value of invalid) {
			try {
				Reflect.apply(createYudaoProvider, undefined, [value]);
				throw Error('invalid bridge accepted');
			} catch (error) {
				check(
					typeof error === 'object' &&
						error !== null &&
						Reflect.get(error, 'kind') === 'config',
					'bridge shape rejected before IO'
				);
				rejected.push('config');
			}
		}
		const empty = createYudaoProvider({});
		check(
			empty.request === undefined &&
				empty.upload === undefined &&
				empty.dict === undefined &&
				typeof empty.adaptOptions === 'function' &&
				typeof empty.adaptPage === 'function',
			'empty bridge supports decoding only'
		);
		record('yudao-thirteen-invalid-bridges-and-empty-bridge', {
			rejected,
			emptyHasTransport: false,
			emptyHasAdapters: true
		});
		return { status: 'PASS', observations };
	} finally {
		runtime.release(context);
	}
}

import { AsamFormSection } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { computed, inject, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamButton, AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamDataError,
	AsamUploadedResource,
	AsamUploadRequestConfig,
	AsamUploadExpose,
	AsamUploadValue
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { UploadDemo } from './upload.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'Data009UploadProtocolConsumer' });
const provided = inject<UploadDemo>('data009-upload-demo');
if (!provided) throw Error('upload demo provider is required');
const demo = provided;
function acceptModel(owner: string, value: AsamUploadValue) {
	if (value !== null && !('id' in value)) throw Error('single resource model is required');
	if (owner === 'handler') handlerModel.value = value;
	else requestModel.value = value;
}
const handlerControl = ref<AsamUploadExpose>();
const requestControl = ref<AsamUploadExpose>();
const handlerModel = ref<AsamUploadedResource | null>(null),
	requestModel = ref<AsamUploadedResource | null>(null);
const handlerProgress = ref<(number | null)[]>([]),
	requestProgress = ref<(number | null)[]>([]);
const handlerSuccess = ref(0),
	requestSuccess = ref(0),
	handlerCancelled = ref(0),
	requestCancelled = ref(0);
const errors = ref<{ owner: string; kind: string; message: string }[]>([]);
function recordError(owner: string, error: AsamDataError) {
	errors.value.push({ owner, kind: error.kind, message: error.message });
}
const request = computed<AsamUploadRequestConfig>(() => {
	const config: AsamUploadRequestConfig = {
		url: '/local-upload',
		params: demo.params,
		transform: demo.transform
	};
	return demo.state.method === 'put' ? { ...config, method: 'put' } : config;
});

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import type {
	AsamDataProvider,
	AsamUploadContext,
	AsamUploadInput,
	AsamUploadFormData,
	AsamUploadedResource
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

export function createUploadDemo() {
	const state = reactive({
		responseCase: 'valid',
		method: 'default',
		calls: [] as {
			owner: string;
			name: string;
			size: number;
			fieldName: string;
			tenant: unknown;
			blobText: string;
			fileIsFile: boolean;
			scope: string;
			signalIsAbortSignal: boolean;
			method: string | null;
			sameParams: boolean;
		}[],
		notices: 0,
		held: 0,
		released: 0,
		abortedHeld: 0,
		transformSameInput: [] as boolean[]
	});
	const params = Object.freeze({ tenant: 'local' });
	const data: AsamUploadFormData = Object.freeze({
		tenant: 'local',
		payload: new Blob(['extra'])
	});
	const pending = new Set<{
		input: AsamUploadInput;
		context: AsamUploadContext;
		resolve: () => void;
	}>();
	let transportedInput: AsamUploadInput | undefined;
	async function transfer(
		owner: string,
		input: AsamUploadInput,
		context: AsamUploadContext,
		method: string | null,
		sameParams: boolean
	) {
		state.calls.push({
			owner,
			name: input.file.name,
			size: input.file.size,
			fieldName: input.fieldName,
			tenant: input.data?.tenant,
			blobText: input.data?.payload instanceof Blob ? await input.data.payload.text() : '',
			fileIsFile: input.file instanceof File,
			scope: context.scope,
			signalIsAbortSignal: context.signal instanceof AbortSignal,
			method,
			sameParams
		});
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 0 });
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 2, total: 4 });
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: -1, total: 4 });
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 5, total: 4 });
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: NaN });
		if (state.responseCase === 'reject') throw Error('local upload transport rejected');
		if (state.responseCase === 'hold') {
			await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
				const operation = { input, context, resolve };
				pending.add(operation);
				state.held = pending.size;
				context.signal.addEventListener(
					'abort',
					() => {
						if (pending.has(operation)) state.abortedHeld++;
					},
					{ once: true }
				);
			});
		}
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 4, total: 4 });
	}
	function resource(input: AsamUploadInput, owner: string): AsamUploadedResource {
		return {
			id: state.responseCase === 'empty-id' ? '' : `${owner}:${input.file.name}`,
			name: input.file.name,
			url:
				state.responseCase === 'unsafe-url'
					? 'javascript:bad'

			mimeType: input.file.type,
			size: state.responseCase === 'nan-size' ? NaN : input.file.size

	}
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		upload: async (config, input, context) => {
			transportedInput = input;
			await transfer(
				'request',
				input,
				context,
				config.method ?? null,
				config.params === params
			);
			return { kind: 'local-resource', name: input.file.name };
		},
		onError: () => {
			state.notices++;
		}
	};
	return {
		state,
		provider,
		params,
		data,
		async upload(
			input: AsamUploadInput,
			context: AsamUploadContext
		): Promise<AsamUploadedResource> {
			await transfer('handler', input, context, null, true);
			return resource(input, 'handler');
		},
		transform(response: unknown, input: AsamUploadInput): AsamUploadedResource {
			state.transformSameInput.push(input === transportedInput);
			if (
				!response ||
				typeof response !== 'object' ||
				Reflect.get(response, 'kind') !== 'local-resource' ||
				Reflect.get(response, 'name') !== input.file.name
			)
				throw Error('invalid local response');
			if (state.responseCase === 'transform-throw') throw Error('local transform rejected');
			const result = resource(input, 'request');
			if (state.responseCase === 'thenable') {
				const thenable = {
					...result,
					then(resolve: (value: unknown) => void) {
						resolve(result);
					}
				};
				return thenable;
			}
			return result;
		},
		releaseHeld() {
			for (const operation of pending) {
				pending.delete(operation);
				operation.resolve();
				state.released++;
			}
			state.held = pending.size;
		}
	};
}

import { reactive } from 'vue';
import { createYudaoProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui-yudao';
/** Host cache and transport are local to this complete example; no URL is contacted. */
export function createBridge(supportsRefresh = true) {
	const state = reactive({
		supportsRefresh,
		generation: 0,
		slow: false,
		failure: false,
		aborts: 0,
		reads: 0,
		calls: []
	});
	let release = () => undefined;
	const record = (kind, context) =>
		state.calls.push({
			kind,
			scope: context.scope,
			epoch: context.epoch,
			requestId: context.requestId
		});
	const provider = createYudaoProvider({
		dict: {
			async ensure(context) {
				record('ensure', context);
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				if (state.slow)
					await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
						const abort = () => {
							state.aborts++;
							context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
							reject(context.signal.reason);
						};
						context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
						release = () => {
							context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
							resolve();
						};
					});
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				if (state.failure) throw new Error('Local host dictionary failed');
			},
			get(type) {
				if (type !== 'members') throw new Error('Unknown local dictionary');
				state.reads++;
				return [
					{ label: '第一成员 G' + state.generation, value: 1 },
					{ label: '第二成员 G' + state.generation, value: 2 }
				];
			},
			...(supportsRefresh
				? {
						async refresh(context) {
							record('refresh', context);
							context.signal.throwIfAborted();
							state.generation++;
						}
					}
				: {})
		}
	});
	return { state, provider, release: () => release() };
}

import { inject, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamDictSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectYudaoBridgeChild' });
const injected = inject('yudao-bridge-demo');
if (!injected) throw new Error('Demo.vue must provide its local bridge');
const demo = injected;
const first = ref();
const second = ref();
const firstValue = ref(null);
const secondValue = ref(null);
const firstStatus = ref('loading');
const secondStatus = ref('loading');
const transaction = ref('idle');
async function reload() {
	const results = await Promise.all([
		first.value?.reload({ force: true }),
		second.value?.reload({ force: true })
	]);
	transaction.value = results.map((result) => result?.status).join('/');
}
async function cached() {
	const results = await Promise.all([first.value?.reload(), second.value?.reload()]);
	transaction.value = results.map((result) => result?.status).join('/');
}
function hold() {
	demo.state.slow = true;
	transaction.value = 'waiting';
	void reload();
	first.value?.cancel();
}
function release() {
	demo.state.slow = false;
	demo.release();
}

import { createYudaoProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui-yudao';
import {
	createAsamDataRuntime,
	defineAsamOptions,
	resolveAsamOptions,
	resolveAsamPage
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
/** All transports and files are local fixtures; this function contacts no endpoint. */
export async function runYudaoBridgeContract() {
	const observations = [];
	const check = (value, label) => {
		if (!value) throw Error(label);
	};
	const record = (phase, state) => observations.push({ phase, state });
	const requests = [];
	const notices = [];
	const ownedCause = Error('host already notified');
	const bridge = {
		request: async (config, context) => {
			requests.push({ config, context });
			return { code: 0, data: [{ label: 'Local', value: 0 }] };
		},
		upload: async (config, input, context) => {
			context.reportProgress({ loaded: input.file.size, total: input.file.size });
			return { config, input, context };
		},
		isErrorNotified: (cause) => cause === ownedCause,
		onError: (error) => {
			notices.push(error);
		}
	};
	const provider = createYudaoProvider(bridge);
	check(requests.length === 0 && notices.length === 0, 'construction must be inert');
	check(
		provider.request === bridge.request &&
			provider.upload === bridge.upload &&
			provider.onError === bridge.onError &&
			provider.isErrorNotified === bridge.isErrorNotified,
		'callbacks must retain identity'
	);
	check(
		Object.isFrozen(provider) &&
			Object.isFrozen(provider.pagination) &&
			!Object.isFrozen(bridge),
		'freeze provider rather than host bridge'
	);
	record('yudao-inert-construction-frozen-provider-and-original-callbacks', {
		calls: requests.length,
		notices: notices.length,
		callbackIdentity: true,
		providerFrozen: true,
		paginationFrozen: true,
		hostFrozen: false,
		pagination: provider.pagination
	});
	const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({ provider, scope: 'yudao-contract' });
	const context = runtime.createContext();
	try {
		const params = { tenant: 'local' },
			data = { body: true };
		const source = defineAsamOptions().request({
			request: { url: '/local-contract', method: 'post', params, data }
		});
		const options = await resolveAsamOptions(source, { provider, context });
		check(requests.length === 1 && requests[0].context === context, 'request context identity');
		check(
			requests[0].config.params === params && requests[0].config.data === data,
			'request payload ownership'
		);
		check(options[0].value === 0, 'request unwrap and core normalization');
		record('yudao-real-core-request-context-and-payload-ownership', {
			url: requests[0].config.url,
			method: requests[0].config.method,
			scope: context.scope,
			sameContext: true,
			sameParams: true,
			sameData: true,
			values: options.map((o) => o.value)
		});
		const progress = [],
			input = {
				file: new File(['abc'], 'local.txt', { type: 'text/plain' }),
				fieldName: 'attachment',
				data: { tenant: 'local', payload: new Blob(['z']) }
			};
		const uploadContext = {
			...context,
			reportProgress: (p) => {
				progress.push(p.loaded);
			}
		};
		const config = { url: '/local-upload', method: 'put', params };
		const uploaded = await provider.upload(config, input, uploadContext);
		if (typeof uploaded !== 'object' || uploaded === null) throw Error('upload echo');
		check(
			Reflect.get(uploaded, 'input') === input &&
				Reflect.get(uploaded, 'context') === uploadContext &&
				Reflect.get(uploaded, 'config') === config,
			'upload passthrough identity'
		);
		check(progress.length === 1 && progress[0] === 3, 'upload progress forwarding');
		record('yudao-upload-original-transport-and-progress-passthrough', {
			sameConfig: true,
			sameInput: true,
			sameContext: true,
			name: input.file.name,
			fieldName: input.fieldName,
			progress
		});
		const row = { label: 'Decoded', value: false };
		const values = [];
		for (const response of [
			[row],
			{ data: [row] },
			{ code: 0, data: [row] },
			{ code: 200, data: [row] }
		]) {
			const source = defineAsamOptions().api({
				api: async () => response,
				params: undefined
			});
			values.push((await resolveAsamOptions(source, { provider, context }))[0].value);
		}
		const badCodes = ['0', 500, null, undefined];
		const failures = [];
		for (const response of [
			...badCodes.map((code) => ({ code, data: [row] })),
			{ code: 0, data: { data: [row] } }
		]) {
			try {
				await resolveAsamOptions(
					defineAsamOptions().api({ api: async () => response, params: undefined }),
					{ provider, context }
				);
				throw Error('invalid response accepted');
			} catch (error) {
				check(
					typeof error === 'object' &&
						error !== null &&
						Reflect.get(error, 'kind') === 'response',
					'one-envelope response rejection'
				);
				failures.push('response');
			}
		}
		check(
			values.length === 4 && values.every((value) => value === false),
			'accepted envelopes preserve false'
		);
		record('yudao-one-layer-options-and-five-response-rejections', { values, failures });
		const pages = [
			{ list: [{ id: 0 }], total: 1 },
			{ code: 0, data: { list: [{ id: 0 }], total: 1 } },
			{ code: 200, list: [{ id: 0 }], total: 1 }
		].map((response) => resolveAsamPage(response, undefined, provider));
		for (const page of pages) check(page.total === 1 && page.list[0].id === 0, 'page decoding');
		let ambiguous = false;
		try {
			resolveAsamPage(
				{ code: 0, list: [{ id: 1 }], total: 1, data: { list: [{ id: 2 }], total: 1 } },
				undefined,
				provider
			);
		} catch (error) {
			ambiguous =
				typeof error === 'object' &&
				error !== null &&
				Reflect.get(error, 'kind') === 'response';
		}
		check(ambiguous, 'competing page paths rejected');
		record('yudao-page-default-keys-one-envelope-and-ambiguity', {
			pages: pages.map((page) => ({
				ids: page.list.map((row) => row.id),
				total: page.total
			})),
			ambiguous
		});
		const owned = { kind: 'request', message: 'owned', cause: ownedCause, notified: false };
		const ownedResult = runtime.reportError(owned, context);
		check(
			ownedResult.notified && notices.length === 0,
			'host ownership suppresses duplicate notice'
		);
		const fresh = { kind: 'request', message: 'new', cause: Error('new'), notified: false };
		const first = runtime.reportError(fresh, context),
			second = runtime.reportError(fresh, context);
		check(
			first === second && notices.length === 1 && first.notified,
			'normal notice deduplicates'
		);
		record('yudao-explicit-host-error-ownership-and-notice-deduplication', {
			hostOwnedNotified: ownedResult.notified,
			freshNotified: first.notified,
			notices: notices.length,
			sameReportedError: first === second
		});
		const invalid = [
			null,
			[],
			'bridge',
			{ request: 1 },
			{ upload: 1 },
			{ isErrorNotified: true },
			{ onError: true },
			{ dict: null },
			{ dict: [] },
			{ dict: {} },
			{ dict: { ensure: async () => {}, get: 1 } },
			{ dict: { ensure: 1, get: () => [] } },
			{ dict: { ensure: async () => {}, get: () => [], refresh: 1 } }
		];
		const rejected = [];
		for (const value of invalid) {
			try {
				Reflect.apply(createYudaoProvider, undefined, [value]);
				throw Error('invalid bridge accepted');
			} catch (error) {
				check(
					typeof error === 'object' &&
						error !== null &&
						Reflect.get(error, 'kind') === 'config',
					'bridge shape rejected before IO'
				);
				rejected.push('config');
			}
		}
		const empty = createYudaoProvider({});
		check(
			empty.request === undefined &&
				empty.upload === undefined &&
				empty.dict === undefined &&
				typeof empty.adaptOptions === 'function' &&
				typeof empty.adaptPage === 'function',
			'empty bridge supports decoding only'
		);
		record('yudao-thirteen-invalid-bridges-and-empty-bridge', {
			rejected,
			emptyHasTransport: false,
			emptyHasAdapters: true
		});
		return { status: 'PASS', observations };
	} finally {
		runtime.release(context);
	}
}

				errors,
				calls: demo.state.calls,
				notices: demo.state.notices,

<script setup>
import { AsamFormSection } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { computed, inject, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamButton, AsamUpload } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'Data009UploadProtocolConsumer' });
const provided = inject('data009-upload-demo');
if (!provided) throw Error('upload demo provider is required');
const demo = provided;
function acceptModel(owner, value) {
	if (value !== null && !('id' in value)) throw Error('single resource model is required');
	if (owner === 'handler') handlerModel.value = value;
	else requestModel.value = value;
}
const handlerControl = ref();
const requestControl = ref();
const handlerModel = ref(null),
	requestModel = ref(null);
const handlerProgress = ref([]),
	requestProgress = ref([]);
const handlerSuccess = ref(0),
	requestSuccess = ref(0),
	handlerCancelled = ref(0),
	requestCancelled = ref(0);
const errors = ref([]);
function recordError(owner, error) {
	errors.value.push({ owner, kind: error.kind, message: error.message });
}
const request = computed(() => {
	const config = {
		url: '/local-upload',
		params: demo.params,
		transform: demo.transform
	};
	return demo.state.method === 'put' ? { ...config, method: 'put' } : config;
});
</script>

import { reactive } from 'vue';
export function createUploadDemo() {
	const state = reactive({
		responseCase: 'valid',
		method: 'default',
		calls: [],
		notices: 0,
		held: 0,
		released: 0,
		abortedHeld: 0,
		transformSameInput: []
	});
	const params = Object.freeze({ tenant: 'local' });
	const data = Object.freeze({ tenant: 'local', payload: new Blob(['extra']) });
	const pending = new Set();
	let transportedInput;
	async function transfer(owner, input, context, method, sameParams) {
		state.calls.push({
			owner,
			name: input.file.name,
			size: input.file.size,
			fieldName: input.fieldName,
			tenant: input.data?.tenant,
			blobText: input.data?.payload instanceof Blob ? await input.data.payload.text() : '',
			fileIsFile: input.file instanceof File,
			scope: context.scope,
			signalIsAbortSignal: context.signal instanceof AbortSignal,
			method,
			sameParams
		});
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 0 });
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 2, total: 4 });
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: -1, total: 4 });
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 5, total: 4 });
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: NaN });
		if (state.responseCase === 'reject') throw Error('local upload transport rejected');
		if (state.responseCase === 'hold') {
			await new Promise((resolve) => {
				const operation = { input, context, resolve };
				pending.add(operation);
				state.held = pending.size;
				context.signal.addEventListener(
					'abort',
					() => {
						if (pending.has(operation)) state.abortedHeld++;
					},
					{ once: true }
				);
			});
		}
		context.reportProgress({ loaded: 4, total: 4 });
	}
	function resource(input, owner) {
		return {
			id: state.responseCase === 'empty-id' ? '' : `${owner}:${input.file.name}`,
			name: input.file.name,
			url:
				state.responseCase === 'unsafe-url'
					? 'javascript:bad'
					: '/local-resources/' + encodeURIComponent(input.file.name),
			mimeType: input.file.type,
			size: state.responseCase === 'nan-size' ? NaN : input.file.size
		};
	}
	const provider = {
		upload: async (config, input, context) => {
			transportedInput = input;
			await transfer(
				'request',
				input,
				context,
				config.method ?? null,
				config.params === params
			);
			return { kind: 'local-resource', name: input.file.name };
		},
		onError: () => {
			state.notices++;
		}
	};
	return {
		state,
		provider,
		params,
		data,
		async upload(input, context) {
			await transfer('handler', input, context, null, true);
			return resource(input, 'handler');
		},
		transform(response, input) {
			state.transformSameInput.push(input === transportedInput);
			if (
				!response ||
				typeof response !== 'object' ||
				Reflect.get(response, 'kind') !== 'local-resource' ||
				Reflect.get(response, 'name') !== input.file.name
			)
				throw Error('invalid local response');
			if (state.responseCase === 'transform-throw') throw Error('local transform rejected');
			const result = resource(input, 'request');
			if (state.responseCase === 'thenable') {
				const thenable = {
					...result,
					then(resolve) {
						resolve(result);
					}
				};
				return thenable;
			}
			return result;
		},
		releaseHeld() {
			for (const operation of pending) {
				pending.delete(operation);
				operation.resolve();
				state.released++;
			}
			state.held = pending.size;
		}
	};
}

点击“展示未提供 refresh 的桥接”会创建另一个独立子应用与本地宿主缓存。 完整说明。

完整芋道桥协议 ​

createYudaoProvider(bridge) 返回 AsamDataProvider；构造时只校验配置与保存宿主回调，不执行传输、字典读取或通知。 完整说明。

桥成员 约定
request 接收 AsamRequestConfig 和原 AsamRequestContext，返回 Promise 中的未知响应。
upload 原样转交上传配置、输入 File/附加表单数据及含 reportProgress 的上下文，返回 Promise 中的未知响应。
dict ensure 返回 Promise，get 同步读取宿主字典，refresh 可选并返回 Promise；读取与刷新按 scope/epoch/世代协调。
isErrorNotified 同步判断原始 cause 是否已由宿主通知，返回 boolean。
onError 接收 AsamDataError，通知归属由运行时协调；已通知的错误不重复提示。

adapter 不配置 Axios、凭据、端点、Pinia 或宿主缓存。 完整说明。

默认适配只展开一层自有 data。 完整说明。

yudao-bridge 完整 TS/JS 示例的“检查完整宿主桥”按钮实际验证构造无副作用、原请求上下文与载荷、上传 File/进度转交、一层响应与失败、分页歧义、宿主通知去重、13 种无效桥以及空桥。 完整说明。

上传数据协议与完整消费者 ​

yudao-bridge 的“展示上传数据协议”按钮在独立子应用中挂载两个真实资源上传入口，分别消费完整资源处理器和未知响应传输。File、Blob、传输响应、资源地址和进度均在本地示例中构造，示例 URL 不发网络请求。原字典与桥的运行时、缓存和检查按钮独立保留。

公开类型 数据约定
AsamUploadFormData 只读字段记录，每个字段为 string 或 Blob；File 是 Blob 的子类型。
AsamUploadInput 只读 file: File、fieldName: string、可选 data。字段名和附加表单数据由调用方提供。
AsamUploadedResource 只读 id、name、url、mimeType 字符串和 size 数字；处理器返回完整资源。
AsamUploadProgress 只读 loaded 数字和可选 total 数字。
AsamUploadContext 继承请求的 signal/requestId/scope/epoch，并提供 reportProgress(progress) 方法；该方法签名本身不是 readonly 回调属性。
AsamUploadHandler 接收输入和上传上下文，返回 Promise 中的完整资源。
AsamUploadRequestConfig 只读 URL、可选 post/put 方法及 params、必填同步 transform(response, input)；原响应为 unknown。
AsamUploadTransport 接收去掉 transform 的请求配置、输入及上传上下文，返回 Promise 中的 unknown，由调用方转换和校验。

类型只描述结构，不保证字符串非空、数值有限、地址安全或 Blob 的内容满足业务规则。 完整说明。

reportProgress 不直接提交模型。 完整说明。

取消会中止该上传上下文，已经取消或卸载的操作不能用迟到资源覆盖模型，也不能再发成功、错误或进度。示例可以持有两个来源的操作，取消后再完成，观察 signal 中止、模型保持为空和进度计数不增加。这里消费上传数据协议，不定义或验收上传入口的原生 file-list API。

完整 provider 数据能力 ​

provider 按需提供请求、上传、字典和数据适配能力；实际使用时必须配置对应能力。 完整说明。

provider 的静态只读引用不等于冻结宿主缓存、原始响应或方法内部状态；dict 的 get/refresh 方法签名也不是 readonly 方法引用。 完整说明。

局部请求错误插槽 ​

可选 error 插槽仅在当前请求错误存在时调用，接收只读 { error, stale, retry }。 完整说明。

retry 不接收参数，返回强制 reload 的 Promise，并遵守取消和卸载规则。 完整说明。

提供该插槽时，自有内容替换整个默认局部错误区；返回空内容也表示主动替换。 未提供时继续显示原错误文字、过期提示和默认重试按钮。无 error 的单独 stale 状态 不调用此插槽；empty、loading 和其他基础插槽继续使用原作用域。

以下完整 TS/JS 示例先制造失败，再等待插槽 retry 的返回结果；成功后可再次制造 更新失败，观察旧结果与模型保留。每次挂载使用独立子 app 和本地 provider。

局部错误定制、等待重试与过期恢复

import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDictSelect, defineAsamDictSource } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAsyncSelectExpose, AsamAsyncSelectSlots } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { Transport } from './transport.js';

const props = defineProps<{ readonly transport: Transport }>();
const transport = props.transport;
const value = ref<string | null>(null);
const control = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<string, object>>();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const dataSource = defineAsamDictSource({ dictType: 'local-error-status' });
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(
	retry: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamAsyncSelectSlots<string, object>['error']>>[0]['retry']
) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Item {
	readonly id: number;
	readonly value: string;
	readonly label: string;
}
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		] satisfies readonly Item[];
	};
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (
				_type: string,
				context: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDataProvider['dict']>['get']>[1]
			) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}
export type Transport = ReturnType<typeof createTransport>;

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const options = [
	{ value: 'basic/ts', label: '本地字典与生命周期 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/js', label: '本地字典与生命周期 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'tag-colors/ts', label: '多选标签颜色 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'tag-colors/js', label: '多选标签颜色 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'local-creation/ts', label: '本地创建、规范项与来源重置 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'local-creation/js', label: '本地创建、规范项与来源重置 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'native-presentation/ts', label: '选项模板、标签折叠与加载插槽 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'native-presentation/js', label: '选项模板、标签折叠与加载插槽 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'yudao-bridge/ts', label: '实际芋道桥接、共享确保与可选刷新 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'yudao-bridge/js', label: '实际芋道桥接、共享确保与可选刷新 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'local-error/ts', label: '局部错误定制、等待重试与过期恢复 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'local-error/js', label: '局部错误定制、等待重试与过期恢复 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'basic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'tag-colors/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/tag-colors/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'tag-colors/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/tag-colors/js/Demo.vue')),
	'local-creation/ts': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/local-creation/ts/Demo.vue')
	),
	'local-creation/js': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/local-creation/js/Demo.vue')
	),
	'native-presentation/ts': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/native-presentation/ts/Demo.vue')
	),
	'native-presentation/js': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/native-presentation/js/Demo.vue')
	),
	'yudao-bridge/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/yudao-bridge/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'yudao-bridge/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/yudao-bridge/js/Demo.vue')),
	'local-error/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/local-error/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'local-error/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/local-error/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('basic/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

<template>
	<div ref="host" />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { provider } from './provider.js';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectBasicDemoExample' });

const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	app = createApp(Child);
	provideAsamData(app, provider, { scope: 'doc-status' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>
vue
<template>
	<section class="data-demo demo-spacing-1">
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active">启用请求</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="multipleMode">启用多选</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamDictSelect
			v-if="!multipleMode"
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			dict-type="doc-status"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		>
			<template #prefix><span aria-hidden="true">状态</span></template>
		</AsamDictSelect>
		<AsamDictSelect
			v-else
			ref="control"
			v-model="multipleValue"
			multiple
			dict-type="doc-status"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		>
			<template #prefix><span aria-hidden="true">状态</span></template>
		</AsamDictSelect>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" :disabled="!active" @click="reload">
			强制重载
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()">
			取消请求
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="readSelectedLabel">
			读取当前标签
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="control?.focus()">
			聚焦选择器
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @mousedown.prevent @click="control?.blur()">
			失焦选择器
		</AsamButton>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }} {{ error }}</p>
		<pre>{{ multipleMode ? multipleValue : value }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="selected-label">{{ selectedLabel }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectBasicExample' });
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamDictSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAsyncSelectExpose, AsamDictEntry } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref<string | null>(null);
const active = ref(true);
const multipleMode = ref(false);
const multipleValue = ref<string[]>([]);
const control = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<string, AsamDictEntry>>();
const selectedLabel = ref<string | string[]>('');
function readSelectedLabel() {
	selectedLabel.value = control.value?.selectedLabel ?? '';
}
const error = ref('');
const result = ref('');
async function reload() {
	const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.demo-spacing-1 {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>
ts
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';

export const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
	dict: {
		async refresh(context) {
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
		},
		async get(dictType, context) {
			context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			if (dictType !== 'doc-status') throw new Error('未知演示字典');
			return [
				{ label: '准备', value: 'ready' },
				{ label: '进行', value: 'running' }
			];
		}
	}
};

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { inject, nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamDictSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamOption, AsamCreateOption, AsamValue, AsamAsyncSelectExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { DemoState, Member } from './provider.js';
const state = inject<DemoState>('selection-local-demo');
if (!state) throw new Error('Demo.vue 必须先配置演示 provider。');
const { tenant, failure, canonical } = state;
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectLocalCreationChild' });
const value = ref<AsamOption<string, Member> | null>(null);
const control = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<string, Member>>();
const createdTexts = ref<string[]>([]);
const providerValues = ref<AsamValue[]>([]);
const message = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const createOption: AsamCreateOption<string, Member> = (text) => {
	createdTexts.value.push(text);
	return { label: text, value: text, raw: { id: 'local-' + text, label: text, value: text } };
};

async function reload() {
	await nextTick();
	result.value = (await control.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	if (result.value === 'success') message.value = '';
}
</script>

ts
import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider, AsamDictEntry } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Member extends AsamDictEntry {
	readonly id: string;
	readonly value: string;
}
export function createDemoState() {
	return { tenant: ref('a'), failure: ref(false), canonical: ref(false) };
}
export type DemoState = ReturnType<typeof createDemoState>;
export function createDemoProvider(state: DemoState): AsamDataProvider {
	return {
		dict: {
			async refresh(context) {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			},
			async get(type, context) {
				await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 150));
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				if (state.failure.value) throw new Error('演示字典失败');
				if (!['a', 'b'].includes(type)) throw new Error('未知演示字典');
				const items: Member[] = [{ id: 'server', label: 'Server', value: 'server' }];
				if (state.canonical.value)
					items.push({ id: 'saved', label: 'Server Omega', value: 'Omega' });
				return items;
			}
		}
	};
}

vue
<template>
	<section class="demo-spacing-1">
		<div class="demo-spacing-2">
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="failReload">
				制造刷新失败
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="recoverReload">
				恢复失败请求
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="cancelHeld">
				取消持有请求
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="holdAndReload">
				等待并重载单选
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="state.release()">
				完成当前请求
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				native-type="button"
				@click="
					state.empty.value = !state.empty.value;
					singleControl?.reload({ force: true });
				"
			>
				切换空结果
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="customTag = !customTag">
				切换自定义标签
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="disabled = !disabled">
				切换多选禁用
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="collapseTags = !collapseTags">
				切换标签折叠
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				native-type="button"
				@click="collapseTagsTooltip = !collapseTagsTooltip"
			>
				切换折叠标签提示
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="popperStyleMode = 'object'">
				使用对象弹层样式
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="popperStyleMode = 'string'">
				使用字符串弹层样式
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="popperStyleMode = 'array'">
				使用数组弹层样式
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="popperStyleMode = 'false'">
				使用 false 弹层样式
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="popperStyleMode = 'null'">
				使用 null 弹层样式
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="popperStyleMode = 'undefined'">
				清空弹层样式
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				native-type="button"
				@click="maxCollapseTags = maxCollapseTags === 1 ? 3 : 1"
			>
				切换可见标签数量
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				native-type="button"
				@click="multipleLimit = multipleLimit === 3 ? 0 : 3"
			>
				切换多选数量上限
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="multipleValues = [1, 3, 4]">
				恢复初始多选
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="multipleValues = []">
				清空多选模型
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<label>单选展示</label>
		<AsamDictSelect
			ref="singleControl"
			v-model="singleValue"
			dict-type="presentation"
			dict-value-type="number"
			style="width: 280px"
			:popper-style="popperStyle"
			popper-class="data009-presentation-popper"
			clearable
			placeholder="演示单选"
			:teleported="false"
			@update:model-value="onModelUpdate($event, 'single')"
			@change="onModelChange($event, 'single')"
			@error="onError"
			@success="
				singleOptions = $event;
				onSuccess($event);
			"
		>
			<template #prefix><span data-testid="presentation-prefix">前缀</span></template>
			<template #header>
				<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="presentation-header">选项列表说明</p>
			</template>
			<template #footer>
				<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="presentation-footer">由本地来源加载</p>
			</template>
			<template #loading>
				<span data-testid="presentation-loading">正在读取本地选项</span>
			</template>
			<template #empty>
				<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="presentation-empty">当前来源没有匹配项</p>
			</template>
			<template #label="{ label, value }">
				<span data-testid="presentation-label">{{ label }} [{{ value }}]</span>
			</template>
			<template #default>
				<AsamOptionGroup v-for="group in groups" :key="group.team" :label="group.team">
					<AsamOption
						v-for="option in group.options"
						:key="option.value"
						:label="option.label"
						:value="option.value"
						:disabled="option.disabled"
					>
						<span>{{ option.label }} · {{ option.raw.team }}</span>
					</AsamOption>
				</AsamOptionGroup>
			</template>
		</AsamDictSelect>
		<label>多选展示</label>
		<AsamDictSelect
			v-model="multipleValues"
			dict-type="presentation"
			dict-value-type="number"
			multiple
			:collapse-tags="collapseTags"
			:collapse-tags-tooltip="collapseTagsTooltip"
			:max-collapse-tags="maxCollapseTags"
			:multiple-limit="multipleLimit"
			:disabled="disabled"
			style="width: 280px"
			clearable
			placeholder="演示多选"
			:teleported="false"
			@remove-tag="removed.push($event)"
			@update:model-value="onModelUpdate($event, 'multiple')"
			@change="onModelChange($event, 'multiple')"
		>
			<template v-if="customTag" #tag="{ data, deleteTag }">
				<span data-testid="presentation-tag">
					已选 {{ data.length }} 项
					<AsamButton
						type="default"
						native-type="button"
						:disabled="disabled || !data.length"
						@click="deleteTag($event, data[0])"
					>
						删除首个标签
					</AsamButton>
				</span>
			</template>
		</AsamDictSelect>
		<pre data-testid="presentation-state">{{
			JSON.stringify({
				singleValue,
				multipleValues,
				removed,
				customTag,
				disabled,
				collapseTags,
				collapseTagsTooltip,
				popperStyleMode,
				maxCollapseTags,
				multipleLimit,
				calls: state.calls.value
			})
		}}</pre>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, inject, ref } from 'vue';
import type { StyleValue } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDictSelect, AsamOption, AsamOptionGroup } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamSelectDataEmits,
	AsamValue,
	AsamDataError,
	AsamOption as DataOption,
	AsamAsyncSelectExpose,
	AsamRecord
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { DemoState } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDictSelectNativePresentationChild' });
const injected = inject<DemoState>('selection-presentation');
if (!injected) throw new Error('Demo.vue must install its local provider before Child.vue mounts.');
const state: DemoState = injected;
const singleControl = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<number, AsamRecord>>();
const singleValue = ref<number | null>(null);
type DataEmits = AsamSelectDataEmits<AsamValue, object>;
const dataEvents = ref<
	readonly {
		readonly mode: 'single' | 'multiple';
		readonly name: string;
		readonly payload: unknown;
	}[]
>([]);
const eventResult = ref('');
function recordEvent(mode: 'single' | 'multiple', name: string, payload: unknown) {
	const snapshot: unknown = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
	dataEvents.value = [...dataEvents.value, { mode, name, payload: snapshot }];
}
function onModelUpdate(payload: DataEmits['update:modelValue'][0], mode: 'single' | 'multiple') {
	recordEvent(mode, 'update:modelValue', payload);
}
function onModelChange(payload: DataEmits['change'][0], mode: 'single' | 'multiple') {
	recordEvent(mode, 'change', payload);
}
function onSuccess(payload: DataEmits['success'][0]) {
	recordEvent('single', 'success', payload);
}
function onError(payload: AsamDataError) {
	recordEvent('single', 'error', { kind: payload.kind, message: payload.message });
}
async function failReload() {
	state.failure.value = true;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function recoverReload() {
	state.failure.value = false;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function cancelHeld() {
	state.held.value = true;
	const pending = singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => singleControl.value?.cancel(), 30);
	eventResult.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	state.release();
}
const multipleValues = ref<readonly number[]>([1, 3, 4]);
const removed = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const customTag = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const collapseTags = ref(true);
const collapseTagsTooltip = ref(true);
const popperStyleMode = ref<'object' | 'string' | 'array' | 'false' | 'null' | 'undefined'>(
	'object'
);
const popperStyle = computed<StyleValue>(() => {
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'object') return { minWidth: '320px' };
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'string') return 'min-width: 360px';
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'array') return [{ minWidth: '400px' }, [{ maxWidth: '460px' }]];
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'false') return false;
	if (popperStyleMode.value === 'null') return null;
	return undefined;
});
const maxCollapseTags = ref(1);
const multipleLimit = ref(3);
const singleOptions = ref<readonly DataOption<number, AsamRecord>[]>([]);
const groups = computed(() =>
	['一组', '二组'].map((team) => ({
		team,
		options: singleOptions.value.filter((item) => item.raw.team === team)
	}))
);

function holdAndReload() {
	state.held.value = true;
	void singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
}
</script>
